Clear preparation. Never false certainty.

Boplo is training support. These are the rules it runs on.

No clearance to fly. Ever.

Boplo never tells you that you are ready for a flight, a solo or a test. That judgement belongs to your instructor.

Official information stays official.

Weather, NOTAMs and operating decisions come from the proper sources. Boplo doesn’t replace or summarise them.

Your record stays yours.

Your notes, flights and hours sit in your account. Edit or delete any flight whenever you like.

Keep your official logbook.

Boplo is a personal record that explains how you got here. It sits alongside your logbook, not in place of it.

Worth knowing before you start.

Is Boplo a flight school or a course?

No. Boplo doesn’t teach you to fly. It keeps your preparation, flights and hours organised around the training you’re already doing with your school and instructor.

Which licences does it support?

You can set a goal of PPL(A), LAPL or a next rating, or choose “still exploring” if you haven’t started. You also pick your licensing authority and country of training.

Does it replace my logbook?

No. Keep your official logbook as your school and authority require. Boplo is a personal record with the context behind each flight.

Does Boplo check weather or NOTAMs?

No. Always check weather, NOTAMs and operating information through official sources and with your instructor.

Can I bring the hours I already have?

Yes. Add your existing flight time when you set up, and it’s kept separate from the flights you log in Boplo.

Make the next lesson count.

Set your licence, add Lesson 1 or Lesson 21, and keep everything after it in one place.
